sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (07:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Welfare check on Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store, no issues to report.
Arrived and completed a sweep of Aotea Square. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards corner of Victoria and Federal St via Wellesley St.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St; welfare checks on Eighty Fed, 77 Convenience Store, News Agency and Coffee Club, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from McDonald's Britomart asking for assistance.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; the issue was a vagrant asking customers for money. On arrival the POI had already left. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from a Data Centre contractor asking for access. Heading there now.
A member of the public approached us about the weather and asked for our job description. Continuing towards office.
Arrived at the office and let the person upstairs. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to Darby and Elliott St.
Welfare check on Lumi Cafe and a chat with the manager for 10 minutes; also spoke to the owner of Celine and his son Omid. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on Footlocker and Cosmetic Clinic. Standing by for security presence due to 3 suspicious individuals (photo/video on file). Cosmetic Clinic workers are locked out of the building.
The 3 individuals have moved on down towards Britomart. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from AS Colour about a male individual who asked if he could steal. Heading there now.
Arrived at AS Colour; told the male POI had left. Description provided: wearing a black T-shirt, backwards hat and face tattoos. Standing by for security presence.
Dolphins players seen eating in The Shelf, with people coming in and out for photos. Standing by for security presence.
A building store on High St has a broken sliding door. Standing by for security presence.
Bumped into Ross from Data Centre with his kids; had a conversation before continuing to stand by for security presence.
Heading towards Chancery Square via High and O'Connell St.
O'Connell and High St all clear; check-in on Chancery all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Fort St completed. Patrol check-in on Fort Lane, Wilson Carpark, Jo & Joes, 77 Convenience Store, Vape Haven, Vapor Kings, Right Track, Evan's Kebab and KFC. Heading to check in on Gore St.
Gore St check-in completed. Welfare check on Smiley Mart, Tribe, Chargrill, King Made Noodles and Auckland Harbour Suites. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store, Evan's Kebab, Coffee Club, St Pierre's, Burgerfuel, Custom Mart and Britomart McDonald's, all clear. Heading to check in on TK Square and Commercial Bay.
TK Square and Commercial Bay all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on lower Albert St.
Woolworths and Aotea Gifts all clear. Heading up Albert St.
Corner of Wyndham and Albert St all clear; check-in on Shakespeare Tavern and Good To Go Supermarket. Heading towards Cathedral Church.
Cathedral Church all clear. Heading towards Victoria St via Albert St.
Welfare check on Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse. Continuing down to Queen St. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards corner of Queen and Wellesley St.
Welfare check on businesses, heading down towards Britomart for final check-in before break:
Welfare check, all clear. Heading back to office for break:

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Standing by at HQ for response calls; charging ops phone.
No response calls to report; still on standby while ops phone is charging, no further issues.
Ops phone to a sufficient percentage; gearing up for patrol.
Geared up and commencing patrol up Queen St.
HQ to McDonald's; no issues, welfare checks complete. Visual check on Darby all clear. Continuing patrol to Aotea Square:
McDonald's to Civic Theatre all clear, no issues; welfare checks completed.
Civic to Aotea Square all clear, no issues or response calls. Commencing sweep on Aotea.
Aotea Square all clear, no issues. Making our way to Elliott St.
Aotea to Elliott St all clear, no issues. Continuing on to Elliott St.
Elliott Street all clear; welfare check on Elliotstables complete, no further issues. Making our way to Victoria St.
Elliott St to Victoria all clear, no issues.
Victoria St sweep complete, no issues; welfare checks clear. Heading to the Cathedral via Federal St.
Victoria St to Federal St all clear. Continuing patrol to the Cathedral Church.
Federal St all clear, no issues.
Federal to the Cathedral all clear, no issues. Continuing patrol.
Cathedral Church sweep clear, no issues; welfare checks completed. Continuing patrol to Albert St.
Cathedral to Albert St all clear, no issues. Commencing sweep on Albert St.
Albert St partial sweep, no issues; welfare check on Albert Mart clear. Completing sweep on Albert St.
Albert St complete sweep, all clear, no issues. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Albert St to Commercial Bay all clear, no issues. Conducting sweep on Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay sweep complete, no issues; welfare checks completed. Heading back up Queen St, no response calls.
Lower Queen St partial completion, no issues; foot traffic mildly busy. Shortland St and Vulcan Lane all clear.
Lower Queen St sweep complete; welfare checks clear, no further issues. Heading to Darby St for welfare checks.
Lower Queen St to Darby all clear, no issues or response calls.
Standing by Darby Street showing security presence while the event is on, no further issues.
Concluding standby on Darby St and resuming patrol heading to High St.
Darby St to High St all clear, no issues; foot traffic mildly busy.
High St partial sweep, no issues. Heading to Chancery via Freyberg Square.
Freyberg Square complete, no issues. Conducting sweep on Chancery Square.
Chancery Square sweep complete; welfare checks clear, no issues. Moving back onto High St to complete sweep.
Chancery Square to High St clear, no issues or response calls. Completing sweep on High St.
High St complete sweep, no issues. Continuing patrol to Fort St.
High St to Fort St clear, no issues. Completing sweep on Fort.
Fort St sweep complete, no issues. Heading to Gore St.
Fort St to Gore St all clear, no issues. Conducting sweep on Gore.
Gore St sweep complete; welfare checks clear, no issues. Heading back up Queen.
Queen St all clear, no issues; foot traffic mildly busy.
Queen St to Darby St clear; standing by as the event is getting busier, maintaining security presence.
While on standby we approached a few patrons consuming alcohol in an alcohol-free zone; on approach they complied and handed the alcohol to us, which we disposed of.
Still on standby at Darby St, no further issues.
Heading towards Lorne St via Timezone shortcut.
Arrived on Lorne St; commencing sweep.
Lorne St all clear. Heading to the Library area.
Library area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Response call from Mid City requesting assistance to remove a vagrant causing a disturbance with local stores; making our way now.
Arrived at Mid City; found the vagrant and respectfully asked them to move along, to which they complied. No further issues; standing by at Mid City for security presence (video on file).
No issues to report on Queen St; foot traffic mildly busy.
Standing down at Mid City and making our way back to Darby for security presence.
Mid City to Darby St all clear, no issues. Standing by Darby St, no further issues.
Standing by Queen St as vagrants are arguing across the street.
Situation sorted; continuing standby for security presence and issues.
Welfare check on Darby Street station, clear, no further issues. Still on standby.
Concluding standby on Darby; heading back to HQ for our first break, no further issues.
First break concluded; heading out for patrol down Queen St.
Just as we were about to commence patrol, notified by the public that a vagrant we had dealt with earlier stole from W Cosmetics.
Completed search and found the stolen item, returned it to the store, no further issues. Continuing patrol down Queen St.
W Cosmetics to Shortland St all clear, no issues. Vulcan Lane sweep complete.
Arrived at HQ and letting in standby guard; heading back on patrol. Note: patrol will be shortened as there will be a one-guard stand down at 20:30. Heading to High St.
High St partial completion, all clear, no issues. Continuing to Chancery via Freyberg Square.
Freyberg Square sweep complete, no issues or response calls. Heading to Chancery.
Chancery Square all clear, no issues; welfare checks complete. Heading back onto High St to complete sweep.
Chancery to High St all clear, no issues.
High St complete sweep, all clear, no issues. Heading back to HQ for first guard stand down.
High St to HQ all clear, no issues. Guard standing down, no further issues.
Welfare check Localito, McDonald's Queen, Timezone centre, Mid City, 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Darby station club, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Elliotstables and street, all clear. Heading back to HQ for guard handover.
Afternoon shift completed; handing over to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Night shift deployed; debrief with afternoon shift.
In office standing by for 3rd guard to arrive.
Welfare check Localito, McDonald's Queen, Avachi Chicken, 77 Convenience Store, all clear. Patrolling up Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square; commencing sweep.
Still at Aotea Square standing by showing presence.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Mayoral Drive.
Standing down patrols; response call from a public member on Elliott Street with a complaint about cars with loud speakers; en route to location.
Arrived at response location; the car with the loud speakers had already left, no further issues.
Arrived at Bar 101; showing presence and standing by for any further issues.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear. Heading back to Headquarters for toilet break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing toilet break.
Toilet break finished; standing by in office until floor checks commence.
Charging ops phone to commence full patrols, responding to any calls.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen, all clear.
Welfare check Darby Street and Darby station, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Dominos, Elliott carpark, Pizza Club, all clear. Arrived at Bar 101 standing by for any further issues.
Police have arrived in the area.
Welfare check Bar 101, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Welfare check Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check Shortland Street, all clear.
Arrived at Sapphires Nightclub; standing by for any further issues.
Welfare check Sapphires Nightclub, all clear.
Welfare check Fort Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Britomart; due to a lot of patrons in the area, standing by for public safety and service.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Removed alcohol from a group of individuals drinking in public.
Removed alcohol from a male individual drinking in public.
Still at Britomart showing presence for the public.
Full sweep Britomart, all clear. Patrolling down Quay Street.
Welfare check Kemuri guard, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Quay Street; commencing welfare checks at businesses open.
Welfare check Danny Doolans; standing by.
Welfare checks all clear. Patrolling up Customs Street West to Albert St.
Welfare check Customs Street, all clear. Arrived at Albert Street patrolling up Albert.
Welfare check Albert Mart, all clear.
Welfare check Skymart, all clear. Patrolling down Victoria Street to Bar 101.
Victoria Street all clear. Arrived at Bar 101 standing by till closing.
Bar 101 all clear, no issues. Standing by till crowd clears out, then continuing patrols.
Bar 101 cleared out, no issues. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen, all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Aotea; showing presence while commencing sweep.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues confirmed. Patrolling down Lorne Street.
Welfare check Rutland St, all clear.
Welfare check top half of Lorne Street, all clear. Patrolling down.
Welfare check Red Radisson and Lorne staircase and mural, all clear.
Whole of Lorne Street all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place; commencing sweep.
Welfare check O'Connell St, all clear.
Welfare check Chancery St, all clear.
Welfare check Metropolis Hotel, all clear.
Full sweep Freyberg Place; welfare checks in the area, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues.
Whole of High Street all clear. Patrolling Fort Lane.
Welfare check Shortland St, all clear.
Welfare check Fort Lane, all clear. Patrolling Fort Street.
Welfare check Commerce St and Fort carpark, all clear.
Welfare check Gore St and Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues.
Whole of Fort Street welfare checks all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Customs Street.
Customs Street West; welfare check Customs Convenience Store, all clear. Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing sweep.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues. Heading back to office for 30-minute break.
Arrived at Headquarters; commencing 30-minute break, charging ops phone and responding to any calls.
Night shift concluded; handing over to morning shift.
